title: A company's return (ITR-6)
note: 2026-10-11: the two demo companies of tools/showcase/pre_companies.py (Zenith Demo Traders - 115BAA; Kaveri Demo Fabricators - MAT, losses).
covers: the company master: CIN, option, directors, shareholders
the final accounts, computation and fixed-asset schedule, mapped
losses brought forward, s.72 / s.79, unabsorbed depreciation
MAT u/s 115JB and the MAT credit
the ITR-6 JSON, checked against the CBDT schema

steps.say: A company files ITR-6. In {product} it goes the same road as a firm: the client, its documents, 26AS, then the computation and the return in the department's own JSON.
Status Company, PAN with the fourth letter C. Its CIN, date of incorporation, kind and tax option - normal provisions, 115BA, 115BAA or 115BAB - go into Part A General.

The directors - the managing director signs the return - and every shareholder of one percent or more, for Schedule SH. A bad CIN, a DIN that is not eight digits, or shares over a hundred percent are stopped here.

The final accounts in the Schedule III layout, the computation of income with the Form 29B book-profit rows, and the fixed-asset schedule by block. Every figure carries its SF Ref: ITR6 PL, ITR6 BS, ITR6 BP, ITR6 MAT, ITR6 DEP.
The 26AS gives the TDS - interest, and 194Q by the buyers - and the advance tax challans. A credit with no matching income is explained once, and the year moves on.
Business income from the computation statement: CSR and the 43B items added back, other income moved to its own head, and depreciation under section 32 from the schedule.
Each block: opening value, additions over and under 180 days, sales. New machinery of a manufacturing company gets twenty percent more - half now, half next year.
Losses brought forward: within eight years and with the shareholding test of section 79. A loss older than eight years has lapsed; unabsorbed depreciation has no limit - what is left is carried.
With the losses the normal tax is nil, so MAT - fifteen percent of the book profit, with surcharge and cess - is the tax, and all of it becomes a MAT credit for fifteen years.
What the documents do not hold is typed once: the turnover of the year 2023-24, the losses and MAT credit brought forward, the section 79 test and the dividend paid.

The ITR-6 JSON is built and checked against the CBDT's own schema before you download it: Part A General, the balance sheet and P&L that tally, Schedule BP, the depreciation schedules, BFLA, CFL, MAT and MATC.
A trading company under 115BAA: twenty-two percent with a flat ten percent surcharge and cess - no MAT, no 80G, but 80M on dividends passed on.
